concept.th-machine-code.def: The tiny numeric instructions a CPU runs directly - the only language it truly understands.
concept.th-programming-language.def: Human-friendly words and rules for writing programs, which a tool then translates for the machine.
concept.th-high-level.def: A language close to human ideas rather than raw machine instructions, so one line stands for many CPU steps.
concept.th-syntax.def: The exact rules for how code must be written in a language.
